text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
How about it? These are high-protein 
carrots grown by everyone at the Ritto 
dorm. Glazing them is super popular, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Those are fine veggies, but our 
strawberries won't lose to 'em. The ice 
cream made with these is super popular 
among everyone in the dorms, after all!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
By letting them smell ramen every single 
day, we grow garlic that's even better 
suited for ramen! It's the Extra-Garlic 
Farming Method, Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...There ain't even a single milligram of 
crushed garlic's worth of logic in that...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Everywhere you go around the academy 
lately, people are talking about cooking 
and veggies... It's become a total food 
craze, hasn't it!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And who made that happen in the first 
place...? Well, it's safe to say it was 
us!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Akebono was such a huge help, wasn't 
she! I'll never forget the taste of that 
pot-au-feu...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~. Look forward to what's coming 
next! I'm gonna keep making things that 
are even more, more BUONO!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... As a pioneer of the food boom, I 
want to keep doing my best from here on 
out!
